note: Captures whose Golden facts (tests/capture/semantic_replay_dev_test.go) form the regression corpus of the current game version. Supplementary captures keep their facts for when they are present; the owner decides the corpus (2026-11-13: only the Build 31 LIVE capture). identificationLimits record, per capture, a stored enemy (encounter and ordinal), stage or kind of play (scene InstanceId) the History cannot name, with the reason; the readiness check content.history-identification fails on every other unnamed one.
